directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Electric 50 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-50-concrete-pump. Copy only the printed cells: Model Electric 50; Motor Power 55 kW; Theoretical Output 26 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Fine Stone Conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m; 13 mm Stone (H / V) 80 m / 240 m; 24 mm Stone (H / V) 60 m / 180 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 140; Dimensions (L×W×H) 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm; Main Unit Weight 2800 kg. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm and Main Unit Weight is 2800 kg. The printed output cell is 26 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. This page does not print a horizontal / vertical pair. Leave that cell blank and ask Xingtai. Do not copy a distance from a different model. The printed power cell is 55 kW. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. This page does not print a maximum aggregate or particle size. Send the size anyway, and ask Xingtai whether this listed part or machine accepts it. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/electric-50-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai. The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asphalt_concrete. It shows: Globe Lane being resurfaced by workers in Chatham, Kent , England. It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动50型混凝土泵列在 /products/electric-50-concrete-pump。只抄已印格子：型号 Electric 50; 电机功率 55 kW; 理论输送量 26 m³/h; 最大出口压力 30 MPa; 料斗容积 0.4 m³; 细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m; 13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m; 24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m; 液压泵 Kawasaki 140; 外形尺寸 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm; 整机重量 2800 kg。运输请抄外形尺寸是 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm，整机重量是 2800 kg。已印输送量是 26 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。这一页没有印水平/垂直距离。这一格留空，并向邢台询问。不要从另一个型号抄距离。已印动力是 55 kW。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。这一页没有印最大骨料或粒径。仍然把粒径发给邢台，问这一已列配件或机器是否接受。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/electric-50-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。这篇配图是 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asphalt_concrete 页面里的内容图片。画面主体：作业人员。它只作询盘主题的参考。它不是河北品锦机械的铭牌，不是报价单，也不是出口案例。

body.en: Put /products/electric-50-concrete-pump in the subject. The published cells are: Model Electric 50; Motor Power 55 kW; Theoretical Output 26 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Fine Stone Conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m; 13 mm Stone (H / V) 80 m / 240 m; 24 mm Stone (H / V) 60 m / 180 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 140; Dimensions (L×W×H) 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm; Main Unit Weight 2800 kg. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/electric-50-concrete-pump。已公布的格子是：型号 Electric 50; 电机功率 55 kW; 理论输送量 26 m³/h; 最大出口压力 30 MPa; 料斗容积 0.4 m³; 细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m; 13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m; 24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m; 液压泵 Kawasaki 140; 外形尺寸 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm; 整机重量 2800 kg。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Output, distance, power and particle size
heading.zh: 输送量、距离、动力和粒径

body.en: The printed output cell is 26 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. This page does not print a horizontal / vertical pair. Leave that cell blank and ask Xingtai. Do not copy a distance from a different model. The printed power cell is 55 kW. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. This page does not print a maximum aggregate or particle size. Send the size anyway, and ask Xingtai whether this listed part or machine accepts it.
body.zh: 已印输送量是 26 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。这一页没有印水平/垂直距离。这一格留空，并向邢台询问。不要从另一个型号抄距离。已印动力是 55 kW。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。这一页没有印最大骨料或粒径。仍然把粒径发给邢台，问这一已列配件或机器是否接受。

heading.en: What to ask Xingtai instead of guessing
heading.zh: 该问邢台，而不是自己猜

body.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/electric-50-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. Also send country and purchase timing as facts about your order. Do not turn them into a promised lead time or an export-country list. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
body.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/electric-50-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。同时把国家和采购时间作为订单事实发来。不要把它们写成承诺交期，也不要写成出口国名单。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。
